## Project Case Studies
- Verixa (Flagship Live Deployment — https://verixa-phi.vercel.app): https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/verixa — Property decision intelligence platform backed by RERA regulatory filings, builder credibility analytics, spatial locality data (PostGIS), and price trend modeling.
- Exertia: https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/exertia — Unified workforce management and privacy-first telemetry operating system pairing a React workspace with a Python background desktop daemon.
- Veritas: https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/veritas — Python and Flask local civic news analysis and TF-IDF cosine-similarity perspective clustering engine.
- Smart Inventory: https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/smart-inventory — ACID-compliant Java SE and PostgreSQL JDBC demand forecasting and automated Twilio SMS replenishment system using Weka ML.
- Smart GST Invoice: https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/smart-gst-invoice — Automated B2B GST computation, ZXing 2D barcode encoding, and iText PDF synthesis desktop utility in Java SE.
